versions.changelog:
- Added Python scripts for direct image and video generation: `scripts/generate_image.py` and `scripts/generate_video.py`
- Provided command-line usage instructions for generating videos, images, uploading files, and listing available models
- No external dependencies required for the new utility scripts
- Updated documentation with script examples and help commands for users

alibaba-wan 1.0.1

- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated with minor edits for clarity.
- No functional or code changes, only documentation improvements.

Initial release of the alibaba-wan skill

- Generate AI videos and images using Alibaba's Wan 2.6 and 2.5 models.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, text-to-image, and image editing (up to 1080p, 15 seconds).
- Audio-guided video generation, multi/single camera shots, and prompt expansion available.
- Access 18 model variants across 2 generations via the Atlas Cloud API at discounted rates.
- Skill triggers for a wide range of creative, commercial, and social media video/image use cases.
